answer_1.quote: We propose Merger-as-a-Stealer, a two-stage framework for extracting targeted PII embedded from other aligned models by uploading malicious model parameters... The attacker extracts targeted PII through direct queries against the merged model.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our attacks using three metrics... Exact Match (Exact)... Longest Common Subsequence Rate (LCSR)... Memorization Score (Mem) uses ROUGE-L.
